title: Every worker session is refused /tmp scratch, writes outside its worktree and plan.md edits
body:
Source: lead session 2026-11-19, standards enforcement audit after #1521 (operator: close every standards gap for good). Evidence: r-agent-state/r-state-paths: only lane sessions are blocked from writing the main checkout (src/hook/scope.ts); lanes.md forbids /tmp scratch (only a comment at scope.ts:281) and lane edits to docs/program/plan.md, nothing refuses them.
Files: src/hook/scope.ts, test/hook/scope.test.ts
Outcome: The edit/Bash scope hook refuses, for every worker session, writes to /tmp or outside its worktree and edits to docs/program/plan.md, naming .krn/tmp/ as the place to write; a CI rule test fails when an untracked agent-state file is tracked outside .krn/.
Proof: node --test test/hook/scope.test.ts: pass with refused /tmp, refused plan.md and allowed .krn/tmp writes.
